name: XHTheme AI Toolbox
author: xhtheme

sections.description:
XHTheme AI Toolbox is an AI toolkit designed specifically for WordPress content creators, integrating various advanced AI large language models including DeepSeek, Tongyi Qianwen, and Wenxin Yiyan. With this plugin, you can easily implement content generation, paragraph optimization, automatic comments, tag extraction, summary generation, automatic aliases, and automatic category assignment, greatly improving content creation efficiency and quality.

Main Features

  • AI Content Generation/Optimization: Use AI models to generate paragraph content or optimize existing paragraphs, with support for undo and model switching
  • AI Automatic Comments: Intelligently analyze article content and automatically generate relevant comments, with support for setting comment quantity and random timed publishing, with a chance to generate comment replies and 10% probability of including emojis
  • AI Tag Extraction: Automatically extract relevant TAG tags from article content, with new tags synchronously generating tag English aliases and tag descriptions
  • AI Summary Generation: One-click article summary generation, supporting customized summary length and frontend style
  • Metadata Completion: Automatically complete article metadata to enhance SEO effectiveness, including article aliases and automatic category selection
  • Multi-Model Support: Integration of multiple top-tier AI models to meet different creative needs

API Usage Limitations

Due to the current high cost of large model calls, some fees need to be paid when using the API interface. Please refer to the payment policy on the APPID acquisition page.

Applicable Scenarios

  • Blog Authors: Quickly generate high-quality content and optimize existing articles
  • Content Creators: Improve content production efficiency and maintain creative inspiration
  • Website Administrators: Automatically generate comments to increase website interactivity
  • SEO Specialists: Automatically extract tags and generate quality summaries to improve search engine rankings

Technical Features

  • Developed based on React and WordPress Block Editor API
  • Supports streaming responses, displaying AI-generated results in real-time
  • Backend task queue processing to avoid request timeouts
  • Fully responsive design, adapting to various devices

Usage Guide

AI Paragraph Feature

  1. When editing an article, select or create a paragraph block
  2. Click the AI icon in the toolbar
  3. Choose “Generate Content” or “Optimize Content”
  4. Wait for the AI to generate results
  5. If modifications are needed, click “Regenerate”
  6. If unsatisfied, click “Undo” to restore the original content

AI Automatic Comment Feature

  1. Enable the “AI Automatic Comments” feature in the plugin settings
  2. Set the comment quantity range and publishing time limit
  3. When publishing an article, click the AI button in the upper right corner to trigger the AI service, and the system will automatically generate a preset number of comment previews
  4. The remaining comments will be processed in the backend queue and randomly published within the specified time

AI Tag Extraction Feature

  1. Enable the “AI Tag Extraction” feature in the plugin settings
  2. Set the tag quantity range
  3. When publishing an article, click the AI button in the upper right corner to trigger the AI service
  4. AI will analyze the article content and automatically extract relevant tags
  5. You can choose to accept or reject the extracted tags

AI Summary Generation Feature

  1. Enable the “AI Summary Generation” feature in the plugin settings
  2. Set the summary length and style
  3. When publishing an article, click the AI button in the upper right corner to trigger the AI service
  4. AI will analyze the article content and automatically generate a summary
  5. You can edit the generated summary or regenerate it

Translations

This theme is translation ready. Contribute translations at:
https://translate.wordpress.org/projects/plugins/xhtheme-ai-toolbox

External Services

This plugin connects to XHTheme AI API (https://www.xhtheme.com) to provide AI-powered content optimization features:

  1. What the service is used for:

    • AI paragraph generation and optimization
    • Article summary generation
    • Tag extraction and management

  2. Data transmission:

    • The plugin sends article content to the API for analysis when users explicitly trigger AI features
    • No personal user data is collected or transmitted
    • Content is processed in real-time and not stored permanently on external servers

  3. Service provider:

    • This service is provided by XHTheme
    • Terms of Service: https://www.xhtheme.com/agreement/
    • Privacy Policy: https://www.xhtheme.com/privacy-policy/

The plugin requires an API key (APPID) to access these services, which can be obtained from the XHTheme website.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the xhtheme-ai-toolbox folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin in the WordPress admin backend
  3. Go to “Settings > XHTheme AI Toolbox” to configure plugin options
  4. Start using AI features to optimize your content creation workflow
sections.faq:
Does the plugin require an API key to use?

Since it needs to call AI large model interfaces to generate content, an API key must be configured for use.

How do I use the AI paragraph feature?

When editing an article, select a paragraph block, click the AI icon in the toolbar, and you can use AI to generate or optimize paragraph content.

How does the AI automatic comment feature work?

When publishing an article, the plugin analyzes the article content and automatically generates a small number of comment previews, with the remaining comments being generated successively in the backend queue. You can set the comment quantity range and publishing time limit, and comments will be randomly published within the specified time, making the comment section more natural and realistic.

Which AI models does the plugin support?

The plugin supports multiple top-tier AI models, including DeepSeek, Tongyi Qianwen, and Wenxin Yiyan.

How do I renew after the resource package is used up?

You can check your resource package balance on the API interface provider’s page and purchase new resource packages at any time. Member users can enjoy additional discounts when purchasing resource packages.

Does the plugin support multiple languages?

Yes, the plugin supports multiple languages and comes with a built-in Chinese language pack.
